versions.changelog:
- Updated output format: strategic analysis now split into four explicit sections (Macro — Industry & Market, Middle — Product & Customer, Micro — Team & Founders, Micro — Economics & Cash) plus a single-sentence Strategic Implication, instead of "Where to Play / How to Win / What's the Risk".
- No code changes; documentation and guidance only.
- Analysis framework in description and instructions updated to match revised structured output.
- All usage, prompt, and example text still reference the original execution flow.

- Expanded strategic guidance with a new "Partner's Playbook" section in the documentation.
- Detailed analytical approach for macro, middle, and micro levels, covering market, product, team, and economics.
- Added practical strategy frameworks and red flag indicators for more actionable analysis.
- No code or functional changes; documentation update only.

- Updated installation instructions and environmental variable setup for improved clarity.
- Refined system prompt: now describes the consultant as having an MBA from Harvard and omits explicit TikTok naming.
- Added clear command-line usage instructions under an "Execution" section for running analyses.
- Updated scripts section: removed reference to analyzer.py and clarified the role of each script.
- Made minor corrections in author background and removed repeated/overlapping credentials.

Built by a 10-year strategy expert (HBS MBA + TikTok). This skill carries the kind of dark knowledge you'd normally pay McKinsey $500K to access — now in your pocket for free.

- Analyzes any company using the "Where to Play / How to Win / What's the Risk" framework, the same one used in Fortune 500 engagements.
- Scrapes live public data via Apify (Google Search, news, Crunchbase) — no stale inputs.
- Delivers sharp, founder-focused analysis with a clear point of view, not consulting fluff.
- Flags each company's single biggest strategic vulnerability.
- Just give it a company name. That's it.
